title: SQL/RAG/CAG/DAG native integration with PostgreSQL business ownership and eight-language optimization, rules only
summary: Binds SQL+RAG-family+CAG+DAG into one native integration plane; PostgreSQL owns structured business data only; stamps the seven user lane definitions; re-optimizes every lane by the eight codex languages with exactly-one-owner; writes business rules only, no implementation.
origin: user explicit 2026-10-03 instruction: SQL/RAG/CAG/DAG native integration, PostgreSQL business ownership, eight-language optimization, all business rules, no implementation

problem.summary: C106 defines the hybrid plane but does not bind SQL native integration, PostgreSQL business-data ownership, the exact seven user lane definitions, or the eight-language exactly-one-owner optimization; subordinate business rules lack a single native-integration reference and risk parallel authority or duplicated orchestration.
problem.current: C106 hybrid plane exists; per-lane native ownership and PostgreSQL business boundary are scattered across language projections and subordinate contracts.
problem.impact: Without a single rule binding, SQL/RAG/CAG/DAG work can drift into duplicated orchestration, cache-as-authority, or cross-language reimplementation.

changes.proposed: NATIVE-INTEGRATION:SQL+RAG-family+CAG+DAG ride one native integration plane;no Python hop;no new authority/scheduler/store/governor/capability;PostgreSQL is the sole structured business-data authority (set-based ops+integrity+RLS+formal schema;never workflow/permission-source/business-decision).DEFINITIONS:DAG=workflow-orchestration sole bounded acyclic global orchestration;CAG=cache-augmentation scoped versioned non-authoritative cache gate;Agentic-RAG=autonomous-retrieval-decider single-agent autonomous retrieval decision;RAG=document-semantic-retrieval canonical doc/semantic retrieval;GraphRAG=graph-association-retrieval governed graph path;TAG=structured-data-retrieval governed structured path;Memory-RAG=long-term-memory-retrieval governed memory path;specialized paths never own orchestration/authority.EIGHT-LANGUAGE-OPTIMIZATION:each capability has exactly one owner;C owns deterministic-runtime+stable-ABI+permission-hot-path+native-tests;CPP23 owns model-inference+native-runtime+audit-engine+resource-governor;RUST owns RAG/CAG/DAG+vector+UI-core+state+lifecycle+IPC+security;CSHARP owns app+API+authorized-workflow+sole-test-orchestration;FSHARP owns business-rules+validation+transform+state-transition+analysis;GO owns concurrent-network+search+file+batch-IO;JS-ESM owns UI-presentation only;SQL owns set-based-data only;adapters convert types/errors/lifecycle/transport only.PATH:Caller>Information-Channel>Permission/Scope>RagApplicationService>DAG>CAG-Gate>RAG-family>Evidence-Fusion>Reranker>Context-Builder>Local-LLM>Citation-Validation>Result.RULE-ONLY:this amendment writes business rules only;no implementation;concrete planners/executors/pipeline-order/tool-choices/storage-impls belong to subordinate owner contracts per B5.

acceptance.expected_state: C106 binds native integration, PostgreSQL business-data ownership, the seven lane definitions, and eight-language exactly-one-owner optimization as rules only, with no new authority and no implementation change.
criteria: seven lane definitions recorded with user-given semantics
PostgreSQL boundary is set-based-data only, never workflow or business decision
each lane maps to exactly one of the eight codex languages
no new authority, capability, scheduler, store, or governor created
no source implementation modified by this amendment
evidence: five-sovereign audit unanimous pass on successor candidate
out_of_scope: concrete planner/executor code, pipeline order tuning, and storage implementations remain in subordinate owner contracts
PostgreSQL retirement or authority migration is not certified by this amendment
